parameters.label: The rubric, set in capitals.
parameters.onTap: Makes the note a link to where the section goes on.
parameters.linkLabel: The link's spoken name when the note alone says too little.
parameters.footnote: A footnote's mark after the label (1), its note under the page.
parameters.trailing: A control at the head's end in place of the note.
parameters.faintRule: Ruled in the hairline's ink rather than the ink.
